investigacion.base:
**Bottom line:** As of about October 5–6, 2026, the question would resolve **NO**. Haiku 5.5 has been officially announced, twice, but it has not been released. There are about 10 days left before the deadline.

**Resolution sources (I couldn't load the pages directly; this is from secondary reports)**
- **Models overview:** As of October 5, 2026, the official model list still shows Haiku 4.5 as the newest Haiku. On September 25, Anthropic's models overview page still lists Claude Haiku 4.5 as the current small model, and there is no Haiku 5.5 entry, price or model ID anywhere in Anthropic's documentation.
- **API test:** On October 4, one developer reported that claude-haiku-5-5 returned HTTP 404, and the models list held 13 Claude models with Haiku 4.5 as the only Haiku.
- **Release notes:** No sources report a Haiku 5.5 entry.
- **Metaculus "credible sources":** This only matters if the official pages go permanently offline, so it isn't relevant right now.

**Recent news timeline**
- **Sept 22, 2026:** Opus 5.5 launched (`claude-opus-5-5`). Anthropic's announcement said "Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 will follow in the coming weeks, with many of the same improvements to performance, efficiency, and safety."
- **Sept 28, 2026:** Sonnet 5.5 shipped, 6 days after Opus. Its launch page repeated the promise: "Claude Haiku 5.5, built for high-volume and cost-sensitive applications, will join the Claude 5.5 family in the coming weeks." Anthropic's X post said Claude Haiku 5.5 will join the family in the coming weeks.
- **Oct 5, 2026:** There is still no date, price or model ID. Nothing more specific exists in any Anthropic document as of October 5, 2026. One tracker specifically argues that an October 15 launch date going around is not confirmed.

**Naming risk:** The name looks settled. The Claude 5 generation shipped Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 but no Haiku, so the line jumps straight from Haiku 4.5 to Haiku 5.5. Anthropic has named "Haiku 5.5" explicitly, so a different name seems unlikely.

**Things that argue against an early release**
- Earlier rumours were wrong. From August 12 one X account posted that a Haiku 5 would arrive within weeks, then next week on August 22 and again on September 8. Neither week produced a model.
- In September there was also a leak claiming the Haiku line would be retired. Anthropic's own announcements contradicted it.
- One timing quirk: if the model launches on October 16 itself, the docs need to be updated before 23:59 UTC for it to count.

**Base rates and timing**
- "Coming weeks" is vague. Sonnet followed Opus by 6 days.
- In earlier generations, Haiku models often came out later than Opus and Sonnet. Haiku 4.5 (October 2025) arrived weeks to months after Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.1.
- By October 16, it will have been 24 days since the first "coming weeks" promise and 18 days since the second. That falls inside a typical reading of "coming weeks," but nothing guarantees it.

**Scheduled events:** I found no announced Anthropic event or confirmed date before October 16.

**Prediction markets:** I didn't find any market prices in my search.

criterios: This question resolves YES if, as of 23:59 UTC on October 16, 2026, Anthropic has made Claude Haiku 5.5 generally available via the Claude API, as evidenced by the appearance of a Claude Haiku 5.5 model (a model ID of the form "claude-haiku-5-5") in Anthropic's official Claude Platform release notes at https://docs.anthropic.com/en/release-notes/api or its Models overview at https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview. If, as of 23:59 UTC on October 16, 2026, no such model has appeared on either page (i.e. Claude Haiku 4.5 remains the newest Haiku model), the question resolves NO. If these pages become permanently unavailable, resolution may rely on an official Anthropic announcement (anthropic.com) or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
letra_pequena: A limited or research-preview/beta availability counts only if Anthropic lists a Claude Haiku 5.5 model identifier in its release notes or Models overview; private previews not reflected on those pages do not count. The release must be of a model branded "Haiku 5.5" specifically; a different Haiku version (e.g. Haiku 5 or Haiku 6) does not count.
razonamientos:
(a) **Time left:** About 10 days, until 23:59 UTC on October 16.

(b) **Status quo:** NO. Haiku 5.5 has been announced but is not yet listed as available.

(c) **Reference class:** Recent Haiku launches followed their corresponding Sonnet launches by roughly two weeks: about 13 days for Haiku 3.5 and 16 days for Haiku 4.5. That is a tiny sample, but both would have met this question’s 18-day window after Sonnet 5.5.

(d) **NO scenario:** Anthropic takes longer than expected to finish or launch Haiku 5.5, and neither official documentation page lists it by the deadline.

(e) **YES scenario:** Anthropic launches it during the next ten days and adds its model identifier to the API release notes or Models overview.

(f) **Resolution technicality:** An announcement or private preview alone is insufficient. The specified official page must list a model branded **Haiku 5.5** by 23:59 UTC on October 16.

The prior launch intervals and repeated “coming weeks” language favor YES, though the short remaining window leaves meaningful delay risk.

Probability: 72%

**(a) Time left:** About 10 days, until 23:59 UTC on October 16, 2026.

**(b) Status quo:** NO. As of about October 5, Haiku 4.5 is still the newest Haiku in the docs. The `claude-haiku-5-5` model ID returns a 404, and no date, price or model ID has been published.

**(c) Reference class:** Gaps between Anthropic's lead model and the Haiku in the same family, when Anthropic has publicly promised the Haiku.
- **Claude 3:** Opus and Sonnet shipped March 4, 2024. Haiku, promised "soon," shipped March 13, a 9-day gap.
- **Claude 3.5:** Haiku 3.5 was announced October 22, 2024 for "later this month" and actually shipped November 4, a slight slip.
- **Claude 4.5:** Haiku 4.5 shipped about two weeks after Sonnet 4.5, though it was not pre-announced the same way.

"Coming weeks" from Anthropic usually means roughly 1–6 weeks. As of October 6 we are 14 days past the first promise, so the first-week portion of that range is already gone. That leaves maybe 35–50% of the remaining probability within the next 10 days. Sonnet followed Opus quickly (6 days), which suggests the staged rollout is moving. Haiku, however, has a history of lagging.

**(d) NO scenario:** Haiku 5.5 needs more evaluation work, or Anthropic spaces out launches for capacity or marketing reasons. It ships in late October or November, which is still "coming weeks" in Anthropic's sense. Alternatively, it launches late on October 16 Pacific time and the docs update after 23:59 UTC.

**(e) YES scenario:** Anthropic follows the Claude 3 pattern and ships within about three weeks of Opus. Something like a mid-October launch (October 13–15, possibly matching Haiku 4.5's October 15 anniversary) adds `claude-haiku-5-5` to the release notes and Models overview the same day.

**(f) Technicalities:**
- The model ID must be of the form "claude-haiku-5-5" and appear on the release notes or Models overview page.
- A beta listing counts if it appears on those pages; a private preview does not.
- A same-day launch on October 16 risks missing the UTC cutoff.
- The name has been explicitly announced, so naming risk is small.
- The October 15 date from the third-party end-of-life tracker is inference, not an official date. It is weak evidence.

Overall, the explicit promise and family-cadence history make a release in the window quite plausible. The lack of any concrete signals as of October 5 and the short 10-day window keep it below even odds.

Probability: 40%

(a) **Time left:** About 10 days, until 23:59 UTC on October 16.

(b) **Status quo:** NO. Haiku 5.5 has been announced but is not yet listed as available.

(c) **Reference class:** Anthropic has generally released announced members of a model family within weeks of one another, though Haiku can lag. As a rough base rate, I would expect a majority—but not an overwhelming majority—of explicitly promised companion models to arrive within three weeks of the preceding launch.

(d) **NO scenario:** Anthropic needs another week or two to finish Haiku 5.5, leaving Haiku 4.5 as the newest listed Haiku at the deadline.

(e) **YES scenario:** Anthropic launches Haiku 5.5 during the next two weeks and adds its model ID to the official API release notes or Models overview by the deadline.

(f) **Resolution technicality:** An announcement or private preview alone is insufficient. The official documentation must list a model branded **Haiku 5.5** by 23:59 UTC on October 16.

The repeated “coming weeks” commitment makes release before the deadline somewhat more likely than not, but the absence of a date or model ID leaves substantial delay risk.

Probability: 60%
